raw_response:
I need to identify the first and last notes in the upper staff (V:1) and calculate the interval between them in semitones.

Looking at the upper staff:
`Add2- de/d/ d/c/B/c/`

First note: A
Last note: c (the final note in the sequence B/c/)

Now I need to determine the octaves. In ABC notation, without specific octave indicators:
- Uppercase letters (A-G) represent notes in the octave below middle C
- Lowercase letters (a-g) represent notes in the octave starting at middle C
- The key signature is G major

So:
- First note: A (which is A3 in scientific pitch notation)
- Last note: c (which is C4 in scientific pitch notation)

Calculating the interval in semitones from A3 to C4:
- A3 to C4 = 3 semitones (A3 → A#3/Bb3 → B3 → C4)

The absolute value is 3.

{"answer": "3"}
